7 August 2026

Inspiration Healthcare Group plc
("Inspiration Healthcare", the "Group" or the "Company")

Grant of awards under Long-Term Incentive Plan

Inspiration Healthcare Group plc (AIM: IHC), the global medical technology company, pioneering specialist neonatal intensive care medical devices, announces that on 6 August 2026, the Company awarded 2,759,141 options under the Inspiration Group plc Long Term Incentive Plan including 1,822,268 to its Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer. The awards are over ordinary shares of £0.10 in the form of options to acquire ordinary shares at nil cost.

These awards reflect the annual issue of long term incentives and annual bonus awards under the Group's remuneration policy. The LTIP Awards will vest on the third anniversary of grant subject to meeting a minimum Adjusted EBITDA and Adjusted EBITDA to operating cashflow conversion targets over the three-year period ending on 31 January 2029. Bonus Awards relate to bonuses awarded for the financial year ended 31 January 2026, vest immediately and can be exercised at nil cost.
